title: 5-Year Sentence Without a Lawyer. Not Guilty With One.

lines.say: Nineteen sixty-one. No lawyer. Guilty. Five years.
Clarence Earl Gideon was charged with breaking into a Florida poolroom. He asked for a lawyer. Florida appointed them only in capital cases.
He took it to the Supreme Court, and won. A poor defendant, the Court said, cannot be assured a fair trial without one.
Nineteen sixty-three. Retrial. Same charge, same judge. With a lawyer. Not guilty.
lines.show: 1963. Retrial. Same charge, same judge. With a lawyer. Not guilty.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
